title: What are Company ID and License ID?
content: A **Company ID** is essential for purchasing licenses and managing your **License IDs**. It enables you to buy and allocate licenses to users, while also providing an overview of the status of all **License IDs** under your account. Please note that a **License ID** is for login purposes only and cannot be used to make purchases. To transfer or rearrange a **License ID** to another Company ID, please [contact our support team](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/ko/support/contact).
content_description: This web page provides essential information about the Company ID and License ID system for managing licenses and user allocations effectively.

title: I purchased a license, but it's not showing up.
content: If you have completed your purchase but the license is not visible in your account, it is likely due to a temporary processing delay, particularly with certain payment methods. In rare cases, license issuance may be delayed when paying via **PayPal**. This is typically caused by a communication lag between servers (PayPal and our system). * **Average Wait Time:** Most licenses are issued within a few minutes to an hour. * If your license has not been issued after **more than 2 hours** , please contact our Support Team for assistance.
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on troubleshooting license visibility issues following a purchase, particularly addressing potential delays with payment methods like PayPal and offering support options.

title: Disconnect License ID from CLO-SET Integration
content: #### **Introduction** The Disconnect CLO-SET feature allows an authorized user to disconnect a CLO-SET integration from an account or a specific License ID. After disconnection, the account or License ID will no longer be integrated with CLO-SET. #### **Who can disconnect CLO-SET integration?** Only Company IDs can disconnect their own CLO-SET integration and the CLO-SET integrations linked to License IDs under their company. #### **Where to disconnect CLO-SET integration?** 1. Disconnect Company ID's CLO-SET Integration My Page -> Account Tab -> Email Section -> Click Disconnect CLO-SET Button 2. Disconnect License ID's CLO-SET Integration License Account Admin-> License Tab -> Click a License ID to view its details -> Email Section -> Click Disconnect CLO-SET Button #### **Requirements** All Enterprise Type(Company ID & License ID) accounts integrated with CLO-SET are eligible for disconnection. #### **What happens if you disconnect CLO-SET integration for a Company ID?** 1. **You can no longer log in to Marvelous Designer using the connected CLO-SET account.** Once disconnected, that CLO-SET account can no longer be used to access Marvelous Designer. 2. **Usage and activity history cannot be accessed or retrieved.** Any usage or activity data associated with the previously connected CLO-SET account is no longer available. 3. **The email address remains unchanged and a****utomatic reconnection may occur if the same email is used.** If the same email address is registered again to this License ID, it will automatically reconnect to the corresponding CLO-SET account. So please please change the CLO-SET account email is different from this Company ID’s email. #### **What happens if you disconnect CLO-SET integration for a License ID?** 1. **The connected CLO-SET user can no longer use this License ID in Marvelous Designer.** Once disconnected, the CLO-SET account previously linked to this License ID loses access to the license. 2. **Usage and activity history cannot be accessed or retrieved.** Any usage or activity data associated with the previously connected CLO-SET account is no longer available. 3. **The License ID remains active and manageable.** Disconnecting CLO-SET does not delete the License ID. The License ID can be reassigned or connected to a different CLO-SET account. 4. **Automatic reconnection may occur if the same email is used.** If the same email address is registered again to this License ID, it will automatically reconnect to the corresponding CLO-SET account. To prevent automatic reconnection, use a different email address or leave the email field empty. ### **Steps** #### Disconnect CLO-SET for **Company ID** 1. Go to My Page and open the Account tab. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432365600281) 2. Click Disconnect CLO-SET and review the policy in the modal. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432365602329) 3. Click to proceed and check the status. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432381651865) * * * #### Disconnect CLO-SET for **License ID** 1. Go to the License ID details page and select a License ID and view its detail page. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432381653017) 2. In the Email section, click Disconnect CLO-SET. (This button is available only if the License ID is integrated with a CLO-SET account.) ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432365610393) 3. Click Disconnect CLO-SET and review the policy in the modal. 4. Click to Proceed and check the status. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53432365614617)
content_description: This web page provides instructions for authorized users on how to disconnect CLO-SET integrations from their accounts or specific License IDs, detailing eligibility, consequences, and step-by-step procedures.

title: License ID Deletion
content: #### **Introduction** The Delete License ID feature allows authorized administrators to permanently remove a License ID from the system. This action is only available under specific conditions and requires careful review before proceeding. #### **Who can delete a License ID?** * Company ID Holder (Enterprise Administrator) #### **Where to delete a License ID?** 1. License Account Admin -> License Tab -> Delete License ID Button 2. License Account Admin -> License Tab -> License ID Detail Page -> Delete License ID Button #### **Requirements** A target License ID needs to meet the requirements below: 1. **CLO-SET integration must be disconnected first.** If the License ID is currently integrated with a CLO-SET account, the integration must be disconnected before the License ID can be deleted. 2. **Active licenses cannot be deleted.** A License ID that holds an active license cannot be deleted. To proceed, you must first end the license subscription. If this is not possible, please contact us or reach out to your account manager for further assistance. #### **What happens if you delete a License ID** Deleting a License ID permanently affects access and data associated with the license. Please review the following before proceeding. 1. **Access will be revoked** Once the License ID is deleted, users assigned to this license will no longer be able to launch Marvelous Designer or use any of its features. 2. **Activity tracking will stop** After deletion, no further activity or usage data associated with this License ID will be recorded. 3. **This action cannot be undone** A deleted License ID cannot be restored. Even if you create a new License ID with the same name, it will not be connected to any previous data. Please make sure to review everything carefully before deleting a License ID. #### **Steps** 1. Go to the License tab in License Account Admin. ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53428436213657) 2. Click Delete License ID ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53428467931033) 3. Review the policy and proceed to the next modal. ![스크린샷 2025-12-22 오후 2.44.25.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53571698977049) 4. Select the License ID you want to delete Only License IDs that meet the deletion policy will show up and be selectable.) ![](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/53428467934105) 5. Clear up all filters and check if the selected License ID(s) is deleted from the License ID list.

content: ## **Expansion in student eligibility criteria, more students to enjoy the opportunity!** We are pleased to inform you of the recent expansion in student eligibility criteria under our updated student license policy. This revision was made to enhance accessibility to the benefits of learning Marvelous Designer, thereby allowing more students to enjoy the opportunity to learn and master this valuable software at their own pace. The revised policy provides students with an affordable pricing option and an extended duration of access, allowing ample time to explore and gain in-depth knowledge of the software. Our aim is to make it easier for students to access the benefits of Marvelous Designer, encouraging them to develop and master this valuable skill set. ## **[New Policy]** ## **License Option** * Student Yearly License: USD 99/Year (Not auto-renewal), up to 2 times within 4 years (since the first purchase) ## **Qualification** * University or college * A college or university that grants degrees after completing a regular course of study of at least two years (including 2-year public or private colleges and vocational schools) * Primary or secondary school * A licensed public or private primary, middle, or high school that provides regular education * Homeschool * Attendees of private CG-related courses * Certification of courses more than 3 months or curriculum schedule and tuition receipt is required _* Students will be asked to verify the student status through either school-issued email address or relevant documents on the purchase process._ _* If you have previously received a student discount, you can still benefit from the new student discount, which offers a 1-year license discount for two times. The eligibility criteria for the discount will remain the same during the checkout process._ ## **Methods of proving student qualifications** ## **Option 1. Use the email address issued by the school** If you enter your school email address, a verification email will be sent to that email address. Please verify your account through the verification email. ## **Option 2. Submit student verification documents** ## **[Institution of a student]** If you cannot verify through your school email address, you can receive a discount by submitting one of the following documents. The submitted document must indicate your name, the name of the educational institution, and the issued date. Sensitive information such as resident registration number or grades should be removed before submission. The document must have been issued within the last six months. * Student ID card * Enrollment certificate or academic transcript * Proof of tuition payment or statement ## **[Homeschooling student]** If you are a homeschool student, you can receive a discount by submitting one of the following documents. The submitted document must indicate your name, the name of the educational institution, and the issued date. Sensitive information such as resident registration number or amount should be removed before submission. * Copy of home school contract * Current membership ID of home school association * Proof of purchase of curriculum for current academy ## **[****Private CG-focused academic institution****]** If you are attending CG-related academic institutions, you can receive a discount by submitting one of the following documents. YouTube, private streaming broadcasts, and other informal online learning will not be qualified, and only official online or offline courses with existing curricula will be qualified. * Certificate of completion issued by formal institution * Course program schedule (at least 3 months) and tuition receipt ## **Notes** * Two-time purchase license (Not auto-renewed) * When you make your first purchase, your 'student status' will be activated. The 'student status' lasts for four years, and after that, you can purchase an additional license once. You will receive two benefits over a total of four years. * Once you have redeemed your student discount, you have the option to purchase a personal license. You can choose between monthly or yearly options for the personal license. * _**Refunds are not available under any circumstances. Please make your purchase carefully.**_ # **FAQ** Q. Where can I purchase a student license? You can purchase a student license on the pricing page by clicking on "[Buy Now](https://marvelousdesigner.com/pricing?type=academic)." Q. How do I verify my student eligibility? By clicking on the "[Get Started](https://marvelousdesigner.com/pricing?type=academic)" button for the student license, the school email verification process will begin. An authentication email will be sent through your school email, and you can proceed with authentication through the email. If you are unable to authenticate through your school email, please proceed with authentication through "Manual Input" or "Document Submission." Q. What payment methods are accepted? You can make payments using credit cards, debit cards, and PayPal. The payment method is a prepayment for a one-year license. Q. Can I cancel my student license subscription midway? You cannot cancel your subscription midway, as it is a prepayment for a one-year license. Please choose carefully when making your purchase. Q. Can I keep my existing subscription for the student license? If you are currently subscribed to the previous version of the student license, you can keep your existing subscription. You can also take advantage of the benefits of the updated student license after your current subscription has expired. Q. Can I cancel my current subscription and purchase a new student license? If you have a current subscription, you cannot purchase a new student license before the expiration date of your current subscription. You can check the expiration date on the [license page](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/license). You can purchase a new student license after the expiration date, but you will need to go through the student authentication process again. Q. How long is the validity period for the second discounted offer after purchasing a student license with the first discount offer? The validity period for the second discounted offer is four years from the date of purchase of the first discounted license. Please check your student authentication validity period on the "[My Account](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage)" section. Q. If I did not use the second discounted offer within the four-year validity period of the student authentication, can I receive the student discount again for a new purchase? If you did not use all the discounted offers within the validity period of the student authentication, you cannot receive additional discounts. Please check the validity period on the "[My Account](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage)" section and make sure to purchase within the validity period. Q. Does student license benefit also expire when the discount benefit expires? The four-year validity period only applies at the time of purchase. If you have purchased a student license prior to the expiration date, you may still use the license even after the expiration date has passed. For instance, if you purchase a license after applying the first discount offer on November 1, 2023, you may purchase the license with a second discounted offer until October 30, 2027, which is four years from the date of purchase of the first discounted license. Moreover, the license can be used until October 30, 2028. Q. How can I renew my Student License? Students are eligible to purchase a discounted license up to two times within a four-year window. Once these two terms have been completed, the student benefit concludes. To maintain uninterrupted access to Marvelous Designer, we recommend transitioning to a **Personal License**. Please visit our [pricing page](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/en/pricing?type=personal) to compare the benefits of our Monthly and Yearly personal plans.
content_description: Discover the expanded eligibility criteria for our student license, designed to provide more learners with affordable access to mastering Marvelous Designer at their own pace.

title: Offset as Internal Line
content: ### Objective Input specific measurements to offset Patterns and segments as Internal Lines. ### Location Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern ### Operation #### Offset as Internal Line 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern 2. Right-click on top of a Pattern and select Offset As Internal Line from the pop-up menu. → The Offset as Internal Line window appears. 3. Configure the settings as needed. Number of Offsets | Set the number of Internal Lines to be generated ---|--- Distance | Set the interval between each Internal Line. All | Set the distance of all segments to be the same. Individual (Ver. 2025.0) | Set the spacing for each line segment individually. Offset From (Ver. 2025.0) | When inputting individual distances, the individual line can be set as the previous or selected line. Reverse Direction | Change in the reverse direction of the selected segment. Both Sides (Ver. 2025.0) | Create internal lines in both directions based on the selected segment. Extend | to Pattern Outline | Extend to Pattern Outline. to Internal Line | Extend to Internal Line of the pattern. 4. Click OK. → Depending on the settings, the internal line/shape is created. → If it is a curve, the curve point is automatically optimized. #### Offset as Internal Line along Curved (ver3.2.0) 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern 2D Toolbar ▶ Edit Pattern/ Transform Pattern 2. Select the two Pattern outlines between where the Internal Lines are created. 3. Right click on the selected Pattern outline and select Offset as Internal Line along Curved (ver3.2.0) → The Offset as Internal Line along Curved (ver3.2.0) 4. Adjust the options below as needed, then select OK. Name | Description ---|--- Number of Offsets | Set the number of Internal Lines to be created. Offset | Set the distance between each Internal Lines. Distance to Segment Edge | Set the distance from the Pattern outlines for the Internal Lines. Reverse Direction | Horizontally reverse the Internal Lines' position based on the Distance to Segment Edge. Opposite Segment | Vertically reverse the Internal Lines' position based on the Distance to Segment Edge. Straight Line | Create Internal Lines as straight lines. Perpendicular Direction | Create Internal Lines perpendicular to the selected Pattern outlines. → Internal Lines are created based on the above settings. ※ Note: * Using the same function, additional Internal Lines can be created between Internal Lines. * When the Pattern outlines or Internal Lines are divided in multiple segments, hold down the Shift key on the keyboard to select them all.

title: TOPSTITCH PROPERTIES: Topstitch Corner Type
content: ### Objective Set Topstitch corner type to extend the stitch more smoothly at corners. ※ Note: If stitch type is Overlock, set the corner type to Curved for smoother extension. ### Location 2D Pattern Window ▶ Edit Topstitch ▶ Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Corner ### Operation #### Curved Corner 1. Select a Topstitch with the Edit Topstitch tool in the 2D window to change its properties. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Curved ▶ On → The selected Topstitch is now curved and smoothly extended. #### Right Angled Corner 1. Select a Topstitch with the Edit Topstitch tool in the 2D window to change its properties. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Right Angled ▶ On → The selected topstitch is now being curved at a right angle. #### Topstitching Smooth Corner 1. Select a Topstitch with the Edit Topstitch tool in the 2D window to change its properties. → Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor ▶ Smooth ▶ On → The selected Topstitch is now curved and smoothly extended. Set this to continue naturally if the edge of the Topstitch is broken.
content_description: This web page provides guidance on adjusting topstitch corner types in the 2D Pattern Window for smoother transitions at corners in your designs.

title: Buttonhole Style Property (Ver. 2025.0)
content: ### Objective Use these options to edit buttonhole styles and materials. **** ### Location Main Menu ▶ Window ▶ Object Browser ▶ Buttonhole **Viewport** Title Bar ▶ Right-click Dropdown menu ▶ Object Browser ▶ Buttonhole ### Operation Object Browser ▶ Select a buttonhole item in the Buttonhole Tab. → The properties are displayed in the Property Editor. Properties | Description ---|--- Information | Name | Enter a name of the Buttonhole. Shape | Select the type of the buttonhole from the drop down icon. Click the plus icon to[ register the Buttonhole as OBJ file](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358452715161). Width (mm) | Decide the width of the buttonhole by millimeters. Material Button / Thread | Type | Set the appropriate material for the Buttonhole. Base Color | Color | Select the color of the base color. Displacement Map | Click the explore button and apply a texture image from Library/Folder, generate with the generate icon. Amount | Adjust the maximum height of the displacement map. The white area of the displacement map shows the maximum height. Shift | Adjust the distance between the displacement map and the garment surface Clipping | Adjust to delete all geometries below the Clipping value. Particle Distance | Adjust the Particle Distance of newly created meshes. Keep Continuity | Extend the adjacent face to eliminate the boundary line. ※ Note: Only applicable to Welded OBJs. Opacity | Opacity | Adjust the opacity level from 0 to 100. Opacity Map | RGB Mode | The encoded map with alpha value in RGB channel. Alpha Mode | The encoded map with alpha value in alpha channel. Reflection | Roughness | Dropdown menu | Intensity | Edit fabric gloss by adjusting Intensity of the Roughness slider Map | Edit fabric gloss by adding and modifying Roughness Map. Map | Select the Browse button next to the Map option to add a Roughness Map to the selected Fabric style. or generate a custom map Map Intensity | Adjust the Map's Intensity. The range of Roughness map intensity was enlarged in (ver. 2024.2) Invert | Select to invert the gloss of the fabric. When this option is selected, the shinny part becomes dull and vice-versa. To use Specular Maps provided in below ver. 6, check this option. Reflection Intensity | The greater/lesser the Reflection Intensity value is, the more reflective/dull the material or fabric is. Metalness | Adjust metallic level. Higher value makes the surface more metallic. Metalness Map | Partially express metallics using a grayscale image. The white parts of the map appear metallic.

title: AI Studio Plug-In Activation
content: ## Overview Marvelous Designer provides AI features as plug-in to support creators’ work. The default state is disabled, and the activation process may very depending on the license type. Follow the guide below to enable AI features and unlock new possibilities for creativity! ## License Type: Personal Individual users can control whether to enable or disable AI features in your account management page. 1. Log in to the [**Marvelous Designer Website**](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/) with your account. 2. Go to **My Account → Account.** 3. Change the activation status of the **AI Studio Plug-In**. 4. The activation state will be applied after restarting the Marvelous Designer software. ## License: Enterprise For Enterprise License users, the availability of AI features for end users is managed by the account’s overall Administrator, in accordance with the company’s AI usage policy. Therefore, if you wish to activate AI features, please contact your company’s account administrator to request activation. Administrators can enable Marvelous Designer's AI features for their team according to their needs by following the guide below. 1. Log in to the [**Marvelous Designer Website**](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/) with your Admin account. 2. Access the **License Account Admin > AI Studio Plug-In**. 3. Control **AI Feature Access** for each End-User with a License ID using the toggle. ## Available AI Feature #### AI Texture Generator (ver 2024.1) When you enter a keyword that symbolizes your envisioned design, the system will automatically generate a variety of fabric texture images related to that keyword. You can experiment with different ideas to produce multiple images, and then compare them to select the texture that best matches your desired style and mood. 📒[**Manual**](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358351055897--Beta-AI-Texture-Generator-Ver-2024-1) #### AI Graphic Generator (ver 2024.1) Simply type in a keyword, and a variety of graphic images related to that keyword will be automatically generated. You can then compare and select from the different versions to create a new graphic that matches your desired style and concept. 📒[**Manual**](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358161486361--Beta-AI-Graphic-Generator-Ver-2024-1) #### AI Pose Generator (ver 2025.1) You can easily create avatar poses using keywords or images. This feature allows you to intuitively bring your desired mood and movement to life without going through the complex process of 3D pose creation. 📒[**Manual**](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/48920289920537-AI-Pose-Generator-Beta) #### AI Pattern Drafter (ver 2025.1) Enter keywords or upload an image to automatically generate measurements and create a drafted pattern for you. This allows you to produce a basic garment pattern without requiring detailed pattern-making knowledge or experience, enabling you to quickly begin creating a wide range of creative designs. 📒[**Manual**](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/en-us/articles/48920347302297-Pattern-Drafter-Beta) ## ##
content_description: Unlock the creative potential of Marvelous Designer by following our guide to enable AI features tailored to both individual and enterprise users.
